title: Accepted workspace launch disappeared before readiness
symptom: A newly accepted workspace launch could be reported lost while image or disk preparation was still in progress.
expected: An accepted launch remains observable as pending until it starts or reaches a terminal failure.

title: A stopped workspace push did not materialize current files
symptom: After pushing a stopped workspace, an existing file retained old content and a newly mapped directory appeared empty in the next sandbox.
expected: A successful push makes the exact current client manifest visible on the next launch.

title: Workspace exec failed through an internal runtime status path
symptom: A live direct-image workspace accepted exec requests but every request failed with an error naming a missing internal container-runtime status file.
expected: Exec succeeds in a running container or returns a stable public error explaining that the container is not running.

title: Direct-image workspace exited before becoming ready
symptom: Images whose configured command completed could cause a persistent workspace launch to terminate before readiness.
expected: A direct-image workspace stays available by default; explicitly preserving the image command gives run-to-completion semantics.

title: Frozen workspace disk resize could lose guest control
symptom: Resizing and unfreezing a loaded workspace could stall while the guest filesystem-grow control request was unavailable.
expected: Disk resize either completes the virtual-disk and filesystem growth within its deadline or returns a bounded actionable failure without falsely unfreezing.

title: Workspace deletion after sandbox writes was inconsistent
symptom: After a sandbox changed a mounted tree, deletion either returned a stale manifest error or produced no output for more than 30 seconds even when deletion later appeared to complete.
expected: Deletion resolves protected changes according to the documented contract and reports bounded, unambiguous progress and completion.

title: Historical guest activity was labelled as a current stall
symptom: After a command exited immediately because an executable was missing, diagnostics labelled an old activity snapshot as possibly stalled.
expected: A stale snapshot is clearly historical and makes no claim about current workload liveness.

title: Rejecting changes on a running workspace waited for a guest snapshot
symptom: The reject-changes command waited until its overall deadline while the workspace was still running.
expected: Rejecting requires a stopped workspace and fails immediately with an actionable stop-first error while it is running.

title: Workspace stop timed out while preserving changes
symptom: Stopping a changed workspace timed out waiting for teardown acknowledgment and left it displayed as dispatched.
expected: Snapshot preservation has an inner deadline that leaves time for VM teardown and acknowledgment, or returns a specific preservation failure.

title: First workspace push ended with an unexpected EOF
symptom: The first push to a fresh workspace failed with an unavailable unexpected-EOF error and an identical retry succeeded.
expected: A fresh workspace push either succeeds once or reports a stable actionable failure without requiring an unexplained retry.
